scope: recent unsupervised deep trajectory-anomaly baselines for the predefined four-dataset EWGB-TAD protocol

common_rules.fit_population: the complete unlabeled trajectory pool for each dataset and seed

coordinate_tokenization.fit_scope: one global bounding box per dataset and seed using coordinates only

common_rules.hyperparameter_selection: official paper or repository settings are fixed a priori; no label-based tuning
common_rules.seed_policy: use every dataset seed in revision_protocol_latest.json
failure_policy: preserve the model, loss, score definition, and random seed
for memory pressure, reduce only the micro-batch size and record the change
do not replace a failed official method with a custom approximation
store failures with command, environment, traceback, and partial artifacts

LM-TAD.paper: Trajectory Anomaly Detection with Language Models

full_benchmark_configuration.scheduler: official linear warmup for 5000 steps then cosine decay

LM-TAD.score: official mean negative log next-token probability (log perplexity)

smoke_test.model_reduction: 2 layers, 4 heads, 64 embedding dimensions, 3 epochs; smoke only

MST-OATD.paper: Multi-Scale Detection of Anomalous Spatio-Temporal Trajectories in Evolving Trajectory Datasets
MST-OATD.input: 18x18 global-grid tokens, grid adjacency, and deterministic position-derived 15-second pseudo-time vectors
MST-OATD.input_limitation: the coordinate protocol lacks comparable timestamps, so the temporal covariate is a shared sequence-position encoding rather than observed clock time
MST-OATD.objective: official spatial and temporal reconstruction losses plus categorical and Gaussian KL terms

full_benchmark_configuration.optimizer: official AdamW for model parameters and Adam for mixture-prior parameters
full_benchmark_configuration.scheduler: official StepLR with step size 2 and gamma 0.9

MST-OATD.score: official 1 - maximum-cluster spatial likelihood multiplied by maximum-cluster temporal likelihood

smoke_test.model_reduction: hidden size 32, 3 clusters, 1 pretraining epoch and 1 training epoch; smoke only

excluded_recent_candidates.GETAD: No public official implementation was located; the method also requires road-graph topology, segment semantics, graph positional encoding, and a link-prediction setup not available consistently across the four datasets.
excluded_recent_candidates.CausalTAD: The official repository states that the original method requires road-network-matched trajectories and road-network information, which are unavailable consistently across the four datasets.
excluded_recent_candidates.DiffTAD: The official implementation targets interacting multi-vehicle or video trajectories and relies on unavailable domain datasets; its sample structure is not the independent route-level task used here.
excluded_recent_candidates.Context-Aware-TAD: The public repository contains only a minimal README and the method requires agent identity and POI context absent from the protocol.
excluded_recent_candidates.FOTraj: No official repository was located and the LLM plus spatio-temporal graph input contract could not be reproduced under the coordinate-only protocol.
excluded_recent_candidates.Anomaly-Transformer: Official code exists, but it is a pointwise multivariate time-series detector; the existing local trajectory version is a custom simplification rather than a verified official trajectory-level implementation.
excluded_recent_candidates.DCdetector: Official code exists, but it is a pointwise multivariate time-series detector; the existing local trajectory version is a custom simplification rather than a verified official trajectory-level implementation.
